roleHint.asr: Turns the call recording into text

rubric.subtitle: The AI scores calls against these criteria
rubric.balanced: Blocks add up correctly — ready to save
rubric.unbalanced: Blocks must add up to exactly 100
rubric.redFlagsHint: Penalties subtracted from the total score
rubric.historyHint: Each save creates a new version — past scores keep theirs
rubric.label: Label
rubric.extraRulesHint: Appended to the AI request. Does not override the rubric — it tells the AI what to pay extra attention to
rubric.extraRulesPlaceholder:
For example:
1. If the agent tries to sell above the official price — set `off_policy_deal`.
2. If the agent pushes the customer to their personal number — set `shaxsiy_raqamga_ogdirish`.
rubric.extraRulesCount: {{count}} / {{limit}} characters — this text is sent to the AI on every call
rubric.promptHint: Assembled from the active rubric. Only one section is editable
rubric.promptNote: Language rules, score arithmetic and the response format are fixed: if they break, the AI response fails validation and no call gets scored. The transcript and date are not here — they are sent separately for each call.
rubric.flagKeyHint: Generated from the label. The AI returns this exact key and it is stored in the database.
rubric.flagKeyInvalid: The label did not produce a valid key — try latin letters.
rubric.optional: Does not apply to every call
rubric.optionalHint: When on, the AI may mark this criterion as “not applicable to this call” and exclude it from the score. When a repeat customer says “send me 50”, needs discovery is not required, and a zero would punish the rep for nothing. When off, the criterion is checked on every call.

sync.title: Pull calls from MoyZvonki
sync.hint: All calls in the selected period are copied into the database. Ones without audio are not scored by AI but count in the activity report
sync.rangeInvalid: Pick both dates — the start must not be after the end
sync.supervisedHint: If off, only the API key owner's calls are pulled
sync.noAudioNote: Only metadata is copied: who, to whom, when and how long. Audio is never stored here — it streams only while you listen.
sync.runningHint: This can take a few minutes — keep the window open
sync.truncated: Limit reached — split the period into smaller ranges and retry
sync.agentHint: Empty means all employees linked to MoyZvonki
sync.windowNote: At most the last {{days}} days can be picked — from {{date}} to today.
sync.oldCallsNote: The range reaches past {{days}} days. Audio for older calls is not retained in MoyZvonki: they land in the list and statistics in full, but are not scored by AI. A long range takes a while — keep the window open, whatever was pulled stays in the database.

hint.sales: An outside conversation — with a customer. Only this type is scored
hint.internal: Both sides are company staff (the number is on the company line list) — transcribed, but not scored

type.notScored: This is an internal conversation between two employees, so it is not scored and does not affect the sales metric.
type.emptySalesHint: Only sales conversations are shown by default. Internal calls and calls whose type is not yet determined are hidden.

sales.title: Sales control

sales.searchPlaceholder: Search by client name, code or phone
sales.emptyHint: No sales for this period and filter — widen the period or upload a SAP export
sales.emptySearchHint: Nothing found for this query. Try the client code (К02711) or the phone without spaces
sales.emptyQueueHint: The review queue is empty — every suspicious sale in this period has been reviewed
sales.windowNote: A sale has no time, only a date. So a call is looked for on the sale day and the {{count}} days before it.

verdictHint.ok: There was a conversation before the sale
verdictHint.suspicious: A rule was broken — checking was possible
verdictHint.not_checkable: Cannot be checked. This does NOT mean clean

skip.generic_code: Generic code: many clients under one code («Разовый клиент»)

rule.R1window: No call before the sale — on the sale day and the {{count}} days before it

decision.title: Decision on the sale
decision.question: Your decision
decision.justifiedHint: The deal happened outside the system, but there is a reason
decision.confirmedHint: No explanation — the check has to continue
decision.reasonHint: The mix of reasons shows the system's own gaps: if half the deals are agreed in Telegram, the problem is not the agent.
decision.notePlaceholder: What was found and what happens next

import.title: Upload a SAP export
import.hint: Register, catalogue or balance — the system detects it itself
import.chooseHint: Only .xlsx. The file type is detected from the headers
import.kindNote: All three exports are uploaded here: the operations register («savdo kunlik»), the counterparty catalogue and the client balance report. You do not pick the type — it is detected from the header columns.
import.idempotentNote: Uploading the same file twice is safe: rows are updated by operation number, no duplicates appear. Order does not matter either — if the catalogue arrives later, the sales links are restored.
import.runningHint: A large file can take a few seconds
import.failed: The file could not be read
import.linkedSales: Links restored for {{count}} sales — the catalogue put the phones back in place
import.phonesFilled: {{count}} phones filled in from the balance report
import.unmatchedHint: Link them by hand in the «Branches» dialog — otherwise sales of those branches stay without an agent

branches.title: Branch → agent map
branches.hint: SAP has no salesperson name — a sale is linked to an agent through this very map
branches.autoHint: Exact match by name. A later import may update it
branches.manualHint: Set by the manager — imports leave it alone
branches.noneHint: Sales of this branch stay without an agent, but remain under control
branches.allAssigned: All {{count}} branches are linked to agents
branches.emptyHint: The list fills up after the sales register is uploaded
branches.manualNote: A manually changed row gets the «Manual» mark and later imports leave it alone. Leaving the agent empty is a valid choice too: some branches do not belong to our staff.

export.hint: By the filter on screen — every row, with the evidence columns
export.failed: The file could not be prepared — try again

agents.subtitle: {{count}} agents · last {{days}} days
agents.activeHint: When off, new calls are not counted
agents.externalIdHint: Used to attach calls automatically. Can be left blank for now.
agents.feedbackHidden: Client ratings are not shown to you
agents.commentsRestricted: Comments are visible to managers only
agents.anonymous: Ratings are anonymous — the author is never shown
agents.avatarHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 5 MB. Cropped to a square.

agents.avatarSize: File must be 5 MB or smaller
agents.searchPlaceholder: Search by agent name or region…
agents.searchEmptyHint: Search matches agent names and region names. Check the spelling or try a shorter word.
agents.deactivateGroups: Marking “{{name}}” inactive leaves the {{count}} groups bound to them without an agent, and they will need re-binding to someone else. Surveys queued for those groups but not yet delivered will be cancelled.
agents.deactivateKept: Group regions, collected ratings and survey history are kept. Re-activating the agent does not bring the groups back — you bind them again by hand under Telegram groups.
agents.deactivatedFreed: “{{name}}” was deactivated — {{count}} Telegram groups were released. Bind them to another agent under Telegram groups.
agents.notEnrolledHint: No number sent to the bot — their groups are never auto-bound
agents.enrollTitle: {{count}} agents are not connected to the bot
agents.enrollHint: They have not sent the bot their number. The bot therefore cannot recognise them in groups, and their groups are never auto-bound.

delete.title: Remove {{count}} employees
delete.hint: No data is lost. Below is exactly what happens to each one.
delete.safeHint: No calls, no surveys, no account — nothing to lose
delete.archiveHint: They leave the screens, but their data is KEPT
delete.alternative: An archived employee no longer appears in lists, filters or group assignment. Their calls, transcripts and scores stay in place and remain attributable. You can restore them from the archive.

importAll.title: Import every MoyZvonki employee
importAll.hint: Missing employees are created as sales staff
importAll.safeHint: Existing employees are NOT touched — name, region, phone and photo are kept. Only missing ones are created, so pressing again is safe.
importAll.detectPhonesHint: Taken from recent calls. Needed for Telegram enrollment, but takes a few seconds.
importAll.runningHint: Scanning calls — keep the window open
importAll.afterHint: Remove the ones you don't need with the Select button. Region is «Aniqlanmagan» — MoyZvonki has no region field, set it when editing.

surveys.subtitle: {{count}} anonymous ratings · last {{days}} days
surveys.responseRateHint: Share of sent surveys that came back answered
surveys.notReadyHint: There are not enough responses yet for a reliable average. Until then no number is shown — half the data leads to the wrong call.
surveys.anonymous: Ratings are anonymous — the author is never shown
surveys.feedbackHint: Newest first. Tap an entry for the full comment
surveys.commentsHidden: Comments are hidden by the administrator — you only see the scores. Ask your manager to open them.
surveys.forbidden: Client ratings are not shown to you yet
surveys.forbiddenHint: An administrator has closed this section. Ask them to open it under Settings → Access.
surveys.emptyRange: No responses in this period — try a wider range
surveys.searchEmptyHint: Search matches agent names and region names. Check the spelling or widen the date range.
surveys.notReadyRemaining: The rating arrived, but the average is still withheld: {{count}} more responses needed ({{min}} in total). That way a single response cannot define an agent's work.

range.customHint: Applied automatically once both dates are set

groups.sent: Survey queued — the bot will post it to the group within seconds
groups.sendBlocked: The group is inactive or the bot has left it
groups.activeHint: Turn this off and the group receives no surveys
groups.agentField: Which sales agent owns this group?
groups.regionSuggested: Detected from the group name — please check it
groups.bindHint: Once both an agent and a region are chosen, the group is ready for surveys.
groups.bindReady: Ready: after saving you can send a survey to this group.
groups.deleteConfirm: “{{title}}” will be removed from the list. Collected ratings and survey history are kept.
groups.deleteOnlyLeft: Deleting is only possible once the bot has left or been removed from the group.
groups.emptyHowTitle: How does a group appear here?
groups.emptyStep1: Add @bonvisalesdashboardbot to a Telegram group — it shows up here on its own.
groups.emptyStep2: If the bot is already in the group, send /bind in that group.
groups.emptyWhy: Telegram gives a bot no way to list the groups it is already in — so a group registers only through those two paths.
groups.broadcastTitle: Send the survey to every group?
groups.broadcastIrreversible: A sent message cannot be taken back
groups.broadcastCount: The survey goes out to {{count}} Telegram groups
groups.broadcastPerAgent: Each group receives a link tailored to the agent bound to it — there is no generic survey.
groups.broadcastNone: No group is ready to receive a survey right now
groups.broadcastNoneHint: A group needs both an agent and a region bound, and the bot must still be in it. Clear the reasons below first.
groups.broadcastForce: No time rule applies: groups that received a survey recently get a new one anyway.
groups.broadcastRealPeople: The message lands in groups full of real customers and cannot be deleted. Press only when you truly need to.
groups.broadcastDelay: Delivery is not instant: the bot checks the queue roughly every {{seconds}} seconds.
groups.broadcastDoneHint: The bot delivers them to the groups itself
groups.broadcastCreated: A new survey was queued for {{count}} groups
groups.broadcastTotals: {{total}} groups in total: {{created}} new · {{reused}} already queued · {{skipped}} skipped
groups.broadcastReused: {{count}} groups already had an unsent survey — no duplicate was created, so no group gets the same message twice.
groups.broadcastQueued: The bot checks the queue roughly every {{seconds}} seconds — the messages arrive within a minute. There is no need to press again.

tree.title: Agent → region → groups
tree.hint: Groups load only when a node is opened. The counts are visible without opening anything.
tree.subtitle: {{count}} groups · {{agents}} agents
tree.tileTotalHint: Active Telegram groups the bot has registered
tree.tileUnassignedHint: The bot could not work out which agent is in the group
tree.tileRegionlessHint: Bound to an agent but with no region — no survey goes out
tree.tileUnenrolledOk: Every agent is connected to the bot
tree.unassignedHint: The bot did not recognise a sales agent in these groups. They never receive a survey — pick an agent by hand.
tree.regionlessConsequence: No region set — no survey is sent. If this is a working group, pick a region; if it is an internal group without a customer, leave it as it is.
tree.regionlessHint: Open this agent's groups that have no region
tree.autoRuleOne: One region: the bot will set «{{region}}» on any new group it binds to this agent.
tree.autoRuleMany: {{count}} regions: the bot will NOT set a region on a new group — it cannot tell which one. The group waits for you in the «No region» node.
tree.autoRuleNone: No regions yet: the bot cannot set a region on a new group — you assign the first one.
tree.agentEmpty: This agent has no groups yet
tree.agentEmptyNotEnrolled: The agent has not sent the bot their number — their groups are never auto-bound
tree.manualHint: Bound by an admin — auto-binding leaves this group alone
tree.autoHint: The bot found and bound it, and keeps it up to date
tree.selectHint: Tick rows — bulk actions appear on the bar at the bottom
tree.selectCapped: At most {{count}} groups are selected at once. Take the rest on the next pass.
tree.backendMissing: The group tree is not ready yet
tree.backendMissingHint: GET /groups/tree is not answering. The page works on its own once the backend lands — press “Retry”.
tree.partialList: This list is not complete — only its first part is shown here. The exact number is in the counter above; the list shrinks as you work through the rows.

enroll.title: “{{name}}” has not sent the bot their number
enroll.what: A Telegram bot cannot see a member's phone number. The agent has to open the bot in a private chat and tap “share my number” once — after that their groups bind themselves.
enroll.modalTitle: How an agent connects to the bot
enroll.modalHint: A one-off step — everything after it is automatic
enroll.step1: The agent opens @bonvisalesdashboardbot in Telegram and sends /start.
enroll.step2: The bot shows a “📱 Share my number” button — the agent taps it.
enroll.step3: Done. The bot starts recognising the agent in groups and binds the groups itself.
enroll.why: The Bot API never hands out members' phone numbers — not even when the profile says “visible to everyone”. So the agent sending it themselves is the only route.

bulk.hint: The action applies to {{count}} groups at once
bulk.clearExplain: A group with no region receives no survey. That is exactly how an internal group without a customer is marked — it is not an error.
bulk.manualWarning: Once saved these groups count as bound by hand: auto-binding leaves them alone and the bot no longer keeps them up to date.

groups.broadcastSkipWhere: They are visible in the tree: the “agent not identified” bucket and each agent's “no region” node.
groups.broadcastEstimate: The number comes from the tree counts. Groups the bot was removed from are skipped too — the exact result shows after sending.

regions.listHint: Sort order sets the position in the list. Check where a region is used before deleting it.
regions.readOnly: Only an administrator can change regions.
regions.name: Name

regions.notePlaceholder: For example: northern districts of Samarqand province
regions.noteHint: Optional — a reminder of which province it belongs to.
regions.activeHint: An inactive region is not offered for new assignments; existing records stay as they are.
regions.tileUnusedHint: Not used anywhere — safe to delete

activity.title: Call activity
activity.subtitle: Who called whom, and whether missed calls got a callback
activity.outboundHint: Calls agents made to customers. Ones the customer did not answer are a separate column
activity.inboundHint: Calls customers made to the company
activity.missedHint: A customer called and the agent did not answer. This is our responsibility
activity.medianNote: Median callback time — {{minutes}} min. Median, not average: one long delay skews the average. Callbacks within {{hours}} hours are counted.
activity.unknownNote: {{count}} calls have an unknown answer status — they are NOT counted. This is data from before the field existed; re-importing calls fills it in.
activity.byAgentHint: "Agent didn't answer" — a customer called and got no answer; that is our responsibility. "Customer didn't answer" — the agent called and the customer did not pick up; the agent is not at fault. Click a row to verify
activity.unreachedHint: Customers who called without an answer and were not contacted within {{hours}} hours. Repeat attempts by one customer count ONCE
activity.chartHint: The breakdown follows the period: one day shows hours, longer shows days. Click a label to hide a line
activity.scope: Across {{count}} employees · who called whom, and whether missed calls got a callback
activity.drillHint: Each customer separately: how many times they called, and who contacted them how long after the last attempt. Contact within {{hours}} hours counts.
activity.drillTotals: {{clients}} customers · attempts total {{attempts}} (the "missed" figure in the table) · not reached {{unreached}}
activity.noMissed: No missed calls in this period
activity.tipOut: Calls the agent made to customers
activity.tipOutNoAnswer: The agent called, the customer did not answer. Not the agent's fault
activity.tipIn: Calls customers made to the agent
activity.tipMissed: A customer called, the agent did not answer
activity.tipClients: How many PEOPLE could not get through. Repeat attempts by one customer count once
activity.tipUnreached: How many of them were still not contacted within {{hours}} hours
activity.tipRate: Share of unreachable customers who were contacted afterwards
activity.tipMedian: How long the agent takes to call back (median). The rate shows how many were called back; this shows how long they waited
activity.allHidden: All lines are hidden — click a label to bring one back
